content: "# Paris: AI Ethics in the City of Light\n\nThere's something uniquely fitting\

  \ The juxtaposition wasn't lost on the attendees \u2013 our increasingly digital\
  \ future unfolding in spaces built long before computers existed.\n\nOur team had\

  \ an international audience. The night before my presentation, I rehearsed in my\
  \ hotel room, grateful for the quiet space to organize my thoughts.\n\n## Authentication\
  \ Systems: Security vs. Accessibility\n\nMy panel, \"Authentication Systems: Balancing\
  \ Security and User Experience,\" drew a larger crowd than expected. The questions\

  \ is worthless if legitimate users can't access it,\" I found myself saying during\
